faq_heading: 2 bedroom townhomes in Cloverdale: your questions answered

faq.q: What is the price of a 2 bedroom townhome in Cloverdale right now?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom townhomes in Cloverdale, 67 sold over the past year at a median of $660,000, with the middle half between $598,500 and $685,000.

faq.q: Are 2 bedroom townhomes in Cloverdale selling quickly?
faq.a: The median was 26 days, and homes sold for 97.6% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which parts of Cloverdale sell the most 2 bedroom townhomes?
faq.a: Cloverdale BC, with 38 of the 67 sales at a median of $640,500.

faq.q: Which buildings in Cloverdale have 2 bedroom townhomes for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Greenside Estates (11 sales, median $575,000); Clayton Rise (4 sales); Kew (4 sales); Sun at 72 (3 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom townhome in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom townhomes that sold in Cloverdale was $360 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom townhomes in Cloverdale compare
A 2 bedroom townhome in Cloverdale sold for $139,800 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($660,000 against $799,800, 217 sales). The strata fee was $360 a month against $383.
Of the 6 cities with 2 bedroom townhome pages, Cloverdale has the third highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $388,750 and South Surrey highest at $780,000.
